description: Cut a segment from a video or audio file. Uses stream copy without re-encoding by default, or re-encodes when accurate cuts are needed.

accurateReencode.description: Re-encode video for cuts between keyframes. Default: false (uses fast stream copy).

duration.description: Optional duration in seconds from startTime (e.g. '30'). If neither endTime nor duration is set, trims to end of file.

endTime.description: Optional end timestamp formatted as 'HH:MM:SS' or seconds. Do not combine with duration.

inputPath.description: Path to the source media file to cut.

outputPath.description: Destination path for the trimmed output file (e.g. './clip.mp4').

startTime.description: Start timestamp formatted as 'HH:MM:SS' (e.g. '00:01:30') or seconds (e.g. '90').

name: trim_media
